## What's changed

- Added card-sized poster and wide artwork responses for Tater Tube Player so
  Continue Watching, Recently Added, and library shelves no longer download
  full-resolution source images for every card.
- Added long-lived immutable caching to versioned local artwork URLs. Artwork
  automatically receives a new URL when its source file changes, so paired
  players can safely keep unchanged images in their local cache.
- Kept the original local-artwork endpoint behavior available when thumbnail
  sizing is not requested, preserving compatibility with existing players.
